$comment: Curated manufacturer aliases: the mechanical comparison key of a name variant (manufacturerKey: case-folded, '.' and ',' flattened, trailing legal suffixes such as Inc./LLC/GmbH removed) -> the canonical brand name. Add an entry only when the mechanical key can't safely unify the variants; a wrong merge hides a real, distinct brand. The canonical name's brand slug (lowercase, '&' -> 'and', anything else not a-z/0-9 -> '-') is the record id prefix. Read by the SDK (normalizeManufacturer, bundled by scripts/gen-types.mjs) and by Genie.
